row_unit: One observed participant visit; unique patient_uid plus visit_week

columns.patient_uid: De-identified participant identifier; all visits grouped for validation
columns.observed: Observed EASI, range 0..72; no imputed validation truth
columns.log2_CCL17: Finite log2 concentration in the development-assay units
columns.log2_CCL26: Finite log2 concentration in the development-assay units
columns.log2_IL-5: Finite log2 concentration in the development-assay units
columns.log2_IL-22: Optional for published-formula comparison; may be missing
columns.log2_IL2RA: Optional nominal sIL-2R proxy; may be missing
columns.stage: 0 before treatment, 1 during treatment; comparator only, not common model input
columns.dose_ambiguous: Boolean; ambiguous initial dose excluded from treatment-stratified evaluation
columns.source_contradiction: Boolean; recorded EASI total differs from complete regional sum by >0.15; sensitivity flag only

publication_policy: Share code, coefficients and approved aggregate tables; do not publish this input or row-level prediction/audit files without authorized controlled data access.
